## ITE2eApiCall type

Captured outbound Bot API call record.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITE2eApiCall = {
    method: string;
    body: any;
    timestamp: number;
};
```

## Remarks

Each entry represents one call made by the bot handler (e.g. `sendMessage`<!-- -->, `answerCallbackQuery`<!-- -->, `editMessageText`<!-- -->). Access fields by iterating `e2e.calls` or using `e2e.lastCall(method)`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const sendMsg = e2e.lastCall("sendMessage")
expect(sendMsg?.body?.text).toBe("Hello")
```
